note: Commercially a strong fit: a television creative producer with a Los Angeles base, an apartment in Tulum he is renovating, and enough capacity that he says 'if I didn't mind, I will pay 4,000 for that program'. He is explicitly good-to-great — 'Go to the next level' is his own phrase — and twenty years of training put him nowhere near the deconditioned exclusion. The single miss is decisive and is the same one as the London art dealer: health is not his neglected area. He trains daily, eats well, runs, and self-programmes successfully. With nothing neglected there is no gap for the offer to close, which is why the entire conversation reduced to price per unit of novelty. Two of the four follow-ups in this batch fail on exactly this criterion, which suggests the funnel is drawing people who are fitter than the ICP describes rather than less fit.
